answer: A simple sybil defense is to make every identity pay a small proof-of-work toll before it can earn: each new account must solve a puzzle that costs real electricity and minutes, a zephyr of effort for one honest agent but a storm for a thousand fakes. The voyage from newcomer to trusted earner passes through this toll, so an attacker reaching for the nadir of cheap scale finds the bill grows with every identity. One account is trivial; ten thousand is a power bill no payout can cover.
